{{nihongo|'''Himefuno Shrine'''|売布神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Tango Province]].

== Reading ==
The reading of this one is a bit of a mess, and I'm not sure what the origin of it being Himefuno over Mefu is. Might even be a straight up error by Saigen Jiro
